hypothesis: The transferable ordinary-edge signal seen in EXP154 can help only when a high-confidence external edge is allowed to break a registered-motion ambiguity without rescaling the parent score or acceptance threshold.
parent: Identical scratch coordinates, 7 um gate, exp(-residual/3) motion score, baseline dummy cost and one-to-one Hungarian topology.
candidate: Add bonus_weight * external_probability only where external_probability exceeds a frozen confidence floor; retain every parent motion score, dummy cost, gate and graph constraint exactly.

source_selection.movies: two source checkpoint-validation movies independently in each reciprocal direction
source_selection.eligibility: nonnegative source official-score and node-recall deltas
source_selection.choice: maximum source official score; ties prefer higher confidence floor then lower bonus

target_evaluation: Only if both directions have eligible frozen configurations, evaluate all 12 opposite-embryo movies in both directions and write both outputs before comparison.
promotion_gate: Positive score in each embryo and pooled, nonnegative recall in each embryo, at least 8/12 nonnegative movies per embryo, and no movie below -0.01.
resource: CPU-only reuse of immutable EXP154 RTX6000 caches; no new accelerator allocation.
